_comment: Live data endpoints the sync engine tries, in order. Edit freely - endpoints for unofficial APIs change. {origin} {dest} {date} placeholders are substituted. If everything fails, the agent falls back to seed data + deep links.

attempts.name: flyfrontier-flight-search-page
attempts.notes: The sync engine now parses this page's embedded journeys JSON for per-flight GoWild fields (isGoWildFareEnabled, goWildFare, goWildFareSeatsRemaining) - visible without login. Bot protection may 403; the agent paces requests 2-4s and stops at the first block. See docs/API-OPTIONS.md.

communityTrackers.name: GoWilder
communityTrackers.notes: Hosted GoWild availability search - fastest way to see which flights show GoWild seats

communityTrackers.name: WildFares
communityTrackers.notes: GoWild companion with maps, multi-hop routing, real-time availability

frontier.officialApi: developer.flyfrontier.com is NDC for accredited travel-trade partners only - no hobbyist access

amtraker.notes: Free, no key. Live positions/status of all Amtrak trains (no fares).

deepLinks._amtrakNote: Historical prefill pattern - Amtrak SPA deep links are not officially documented; if params stop prefilling, the page still opens the booking search.
